description: The JobCrawls collective agreements (työehtosopimus, TES) directory, from Finlex: for each agreement its name, the scope of application, the date and number of the latest decision, the Finlex link and whether the Confirmation Board's latest annual review found it generally binding (yleissitova; unknown when no review names it). English and Swedish names and scope texts are unofficial machine translations of the Finnish originals, and each result says which. Search by a word from the name or scope. Minimum pay per role is a separate tool (collective_agreement_minimum). Reuse: figures may be quoted with a visible link to the jobcrawls.com page in the result (or "JobCrawls (jobcrawls.com)" where a link is impossible); each result repeats this in dataUse.

generallyBindingOnly.description: Only agreements listed as generally binding (yleissitova).

locale.description: Language of the result and of the linked jobcrawls.com pages. Defaults to English.

query.description: A word from the agreement name or its scope, in any of the three languages.

name: list_collective_agreements

basis.description: Where the figures come from: source, as-of date and sample.

dataUse.description: What may be reused from this result and how to credit JobCrawls.

limitReached.description: Present when a weekly limit stopped the call: which limit, its size and when it resets.

links.description: JobCrawls pages for the jobs and companies mentioned.

openInJobCrawls.description: A JobCrawls page with the full result.

title: Collective agreements directory
